persona: Computer service shop technician moving into corporate desktop support
resumeText:
Rahul Yadav | Lucknow | rahul.yadav@example.com

SUMMARY
Hardware and networking technician looking for a desktop support role.

EXPERIENCE
Support Technician, Gomti Computer Care, Lucknow (2024 - present)
- Diagnose and repair 15 to 20 laptops and desktops a week, including RAM, SSD and motherboard faults.
- Install Windows 11 and drivers, and set up shared printers for small offices.
- Configure Wi-Fi routers, DHCP ranges and static IPs for client offices.
- Reset user passwords and unlock accounts in Active Directory for a 60-seat client office on an annual contract.
- Explain fixes to customers on the phone and in person, and keep a job log in Excel.

EDUCATION
BCA, University of Lucknow, 2024

SKILLS
Hardware troubleshooting, Windows 10/11, LAN/Wi-Fi, ITIL basics, MS Office
